versions.changelog: Clarify CLI vs library scope, complete flags, add triggers and guardrails

- Initial release of the file2md skill.
- Provides Markdown conversion for PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, HTML, CSV, and various file types using the @covoyage/file2md CLI.
- Supports command usage with both global and npx installs.
- Lists supported formats, including documents, media files, and email.
- Documents optional integration with Azure Document Intelligence and Content Understanding.
- Includes tips on command flags, environment variables, and Node.js library usage.
